verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are built to be driven headlessly. They are created, executed and managed programmatically through the Python, JS and Go SDKs, including sb.exec and logs fetch/tail APIs, plus an official CLI. A community builder ran GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on Modal Sandboxes, which corroborates CI-style automation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on CI usage (non-interactive auth/token setup in CI pipelines, an official CI/GitHub Actions integration guide) and independent hands-on reports of using Modal as a step within CI pipelines rather than as runner infrastructure.
